_design_notes: - current_task: kept reset_group=1 negative-success items (both should be NO);
ADDED redundant success_item asking the same separation fact in positive form ('three cups standing separately, none on top of another').
Reverse task success = cups are separated. Their exact positions DO NOT matter — the next forward attempt re-detects each cup via AprilTag, so any non-stacked layout is acceptable.

This extra item just gives the score a positive-weight signal alongside the two negative-weight rg=1 items, so a successful unstack is rewarded by a positive contribution rather than only by 'absence of stacking'.
- safety items (id 1, 2) ADDED BACK at low weight (0.15 each).

common.question: Is the robot arm and gripper visibly intact (no broken parts, no hanging cables, no obvious damage)?
Is the work area clear of task objects that have fallen on the floor or far outside the working surface?
Are all the cups upright (none knocked over or lying on their side)?
Is the workspace free of spilled materials or foreign objects?

current_task.question: Is the purple cup stacked on top of the blue cup?
Is the pink cup stacked on top of the purple cup?
Are the three cups standing as three separate cups on the table, with no cup on top of another?
Based on the object detection status provided, is the pick cup successfully detected?
